description: How TmInlineDiff places the changes inside the text: Inline flows them with their context (the presentation the component always had), Stacked gives each hunk its own row so the deletion and the insertion of a change read one below the other - the presentation for a one-hunk proposal of a whole value, and Whole is two named boxes (proposed first, then current) for a long or multi-line field value. The layout is about the user interface only - every layout shows exactly the same hunks and the same TextDiffResult.Apply output, and every decision surface keeps working.

members.name: Inline
members.description: The changes flow inside the surrounding text — the default and the presentation the component always had.

members.name: Stacked
members.description: Each hunk becomes its own row, so the deletion and the insertion of a change read one below the other.

members.name: Whole
members.description: Two named boxes — the proposed (new) value first, then the current (old) value — each a real ins / del. Meant for a long or multi-line field value.
